Main try na karna accept nahi karta.
Success se zyada failure se learn hota.
"Opportunity na aaye, darwaza khud banao."
Khud par vishwas rakho! Apni abilities par yakeen rakho!
"Tum jo karte usse matter banta—tum decide karo kaunsa."
"Jit unki hoti jo sabr se tikte."
Cheezon ko dekhne ka nazariya badlo—cheez badalti.
Hamare peeche aur aage jo hai, woh humare andar jo hai usse chhota hai.
Life ke liye dreams zaroori hain.
Consistent raho.
Badlav khud bano.
